text:
ashley_support: FYI — ACME reported a regression after model v2.7 canary. Tool/function calls are failing schema validation. Customer sees 400 schema_violation: 'tool_args.metadata' missing and 'tool_args' is string not object. Started after canary hit ~25% last night. :rotating_light:

mike_platform: can you paste the failing request + response? which model variant and region?

ashley_support: model: redwood/encoder-v2.7, region: eu-west-1. Here's a sanitized repro from the customer:
```http
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/encoder-v2.7",
  "input": "Summarize",
  "tools": [
    {"name":"fetch_profile","args":"{\\"user_id\\":123}"}
  ]
}
```
Response:
```json
{ "error": "schema_violation", "message": "tool_args must be object, got string; missing field 'metadata'" }
```

jordan_ml: that looks like tool args are being double-encoded. We changed the kernel arg-serializer in v2.7 to optimize KV cache keys — could be coercing objects to strings. Can try repro with a local tool hook.

ashley_support: customer insists client unchanged. Worked on v2.6. Failures across multiple account keys.

mike_platform: @jordan_ml can you confirm if the serializer change landed in runtime? link the PR if you have it.

jordan_ml: PR #5823 modified arg serialization for some model shims. Running a quick local test now. If confirmed, we should rollback canary to stop customer impact.

sre-bot: Deploy canary rollout increased to 25% for redwood/encoder-v2.7 in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-16T23:40Z.

mike_platform: @eng-oncall can we gate eu-west-1 for this model? Also need logs: ashley, can you provide a request_id from the customer?

ashley_support: provided via DM: req_id=acme-req-20260316-8841

eng-oncall: pulled logs — consistent 'type_mismatch' on tool_args; stack shows arg_serializer.encode_object -> encode_string in runtime path.

jordan_ml: confirmed locally — v2.7 runtime path encodes dict args as JSON strings for some kernels. This regressed toolcall validation. Root cause: serializer now treats mappings with non-primitive values as serialized strings for cache keys. Fix is to preserve tool args shape for the tool-calling path. I'll open an urgent PR to revert that part of the change.

mike_platform: recommendation: pause canary, rollback to v2.6 in eu-west-1, notify customer. ashley please coordinate rollback and support message.

ashley_support: told ACME we're investigating and will roll back if needed. They asked for ETA.

jordan_ml: PR ready to revert, running unit + integration tests. If good, hotfix and re-canary in ~2-3 hours. Tracking now.

deploy-bot: Rollback request acknowledged. Initiating rollback of redwood/encoder-v2.7 -> redwood/encoder-v2.6 in eu-west-1. Rollback started at 2026-03-17T00:05Z :gear:

ashley_support: ACME confirmed reduced failures after we disabled canary traffic to the eu-west cluster. They want confirmation when full rollback completes.

mike_platform: monitoring metrics — toolcall 4xx rate in eu-west fell from 1.9% -> 0.3% after partial rollback. Still watching.

jordan_ml: after hotfix lands I'll run canary test harness against nested tool args including 'metadata' and add a regression test so arg serializer changes can't touch the toolcall path.

ashley_support: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with the timeline and file ticket 98432 with notes from this thread.

mike_platform: :thumbsup: keep tickets and postmortem notes. If ACME escalates, consider offering a credit.
